description: This file defines data structures related to post-mortem call stack information within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes classes for representing call stack data and post-mortem data, with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: CallstackData
classes.description: Represents individual call stack frame information including address, function name, module, and line number.

classes.name: PostMortemData
classes.description: Contains post-mortem information including a collection of call stacks and associated metadata.

classes.name: PostMortemData::Callstack
classes.description: Represents a call stack with an ID and a list of call stack frames.

methods.name: CallstackData()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing JSON container and adding JSON fields.

methods.name: CallstackData(const Core::callstack_info& source)
methods.description: Constructs CallstackData from a callstack_info source, converting address and setting fields.

methods.name: PostMortemData()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing JSON container and adding JSON fields.
